messages:
lee (auditor): Hi team — following up for the SOC 2 engagement. We need evidence for access/log retention and KMS/HSM key lifecycle for controls related to logging, key rotation, and incident repro. Specifically: access log exports for a 13-month window, KMS rotation policy, HSM custody attestation, and a short repro for the API auth error referenced in Incident INC-2026-123. Can you confirm what you can provide and timelines?
sara (security): @lee (auditor) thanks — we can provide log export + KMS metadata and attestations. Need to confirm exact S3 path and whether you want raw logs or redacted. Also want to confirm scope: production only or prod+staging?
lee (auditor): Production only. Raw logs preferred; if any PII appears we accept redacted copies but need to see redaction process. Also need the KMS key rotation records (who rotated, when, key alias) and HSM custody proof (vendor statement + keywrap logs).
michael (support): For the API auth error repro I can paste the minimal steps we used to reproduce the 401 spike. Repro steps: 
```bash
# reproduce auth token expiry behaviour seen in INC-2026-123
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
# rotate token or use expired token to get 401
```
Observed response: 401 Unauthorized with body `{"error":"invalid_token","reason":"expired"}`. Ticket INC-2026-123 has full logs.
sara (security): Thanks @michael — please also provide the internal trace IDs for the requests (we'll match to access logs).
anita (eng-infra): Log export details: we store production access logs in s3://redwood-audit/prod/access-logs/YYYY/MM/DD/*.gz. KMS envelope metadata lives in s3://redwood-audit/prod/crypto/kms-metadata/ and we retain 18 months for internal purposes but provide 13 months slice for SOC2. KMS info: primary alias = alias/redwood-prod-primary, key-id = 1234abcd-... (redacted in public). Rotation schedule: automated monthly rotation via HSM-backed KMS (Thales nShield). HSM custody attestation: we have vendor-signed statement and HSM operation logs in s3://redwood-audit/prod/hsm/attestations/.
lee (auditor): Can you provide a manifest with exact object keys and a sample of the log file (first 200 lines) plus the KMS key rotation event records? We also need the signed HSM vendor attestation PDF. Timeline: auditor team needs these within 5 business days if possible.
sara (security): Understood. We'll provide a manifest (CSV) and a redaction script note. Note: raw logs contain internal IPs and user emails; we'll provide raw logs in a temporary bucket with strict ACLs and a short-lived presigned link. Access will be audited.
anita (eng-infra): Example export command for our ops runbook: 
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/prod/access-logs/2025/10/ - --recursive --exclude "*.tmp" --region us-east-1
# create tar then encrypt with KMS key alias/redwood-audit-export and upload to staging bucket
```
We will also provide a short script showing redaction steps.
lee (auditor): Good. Also need the control mapping: which control IDs these artifacts satisfy (e.g., logging retention, key lifecycle control). Please map artifacts to controls in the manifest.
michael (support): Quick note on the incident repro: the 401 surge correlated with a rollout on 2025-10-12 where a short TTL change was applied to our token provider. I can point to the deploy tag and circle CI job: deploy/2025-10-12-token-ttl v2. Repro steps above + trace IDs will let you see the same 401s.
sara (security): Action plan: 1) anita will generate manifest + sample files; 2) michael will drop trace IDs and incident timeline; 3) I will prepare a redaction statement and generate presigned links. ETA 3 business days. If we need signed attestation from legal for HSM vendor, add 2 more days.
anita (eng-infra): Starting export now — I'll post the manifest and a short checklist when the job finishes. Deploy-bot: export job started (job-id: export-20260315-77). :rocket:
deploy-bot: export job export-20260315-77 status: running. Logs at https://internal-ops/redwood/exports/export-20260315-77
lee (auditor): Thanks all — please post the manifest here when ready and I'll confirm whether any follow-ups are required. Also please flag if anything is redacted so we can get the redaction process documented. :eyes: 
sara (security): Will do. Tagging @anita and @michael.
anita (eng-infra): Manifest posted: https://redwood-internal/secure-artifacts/manifest-export-20260315.csv (access controls will be applied). Sample log sample: attached in the manifest as sample-access-20251012.txt.gz. KMS rotation events CSV included: kms-rotations-13mo.csv. HSM attestation uploaded: hsm-attestation-2025-10-14.pdf.
lee (auditor): Received the manifest link. I see the sample and the rotations CSV. One follow-up: can you provide the KMS key policy change history? We need the change author + timestamp.
sara (security): We can provide KMS CloudTrail records showing PutKeyPolicy and ScheduleKeyRotation events. Those are in cloudtrail-prod/AWSLogs/123456789012/CloudTrail/us-east-1/2025/10/14/record.json.gz (manifest includes path). We'll surface PutKeyPolicy entries.
lee (auditor): Perfect. I'll review and come back with any clarifying Qs. If all looks good, we'll close the evidence request. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:"
